database_summary: Soccer match dataset (FIFA-like). Core entities are Player, Team, League, Country and Match. Time-varying attributes for players and teams are captured in Player_Attributes and Team_Attributes (dated snapshots). Match rows are event/fixture records with lineups, per-match statistics and betting odds. Relationships: Match references Team (home/away) and League/Country; Player_Attributes and Team_Attributes reference Player and Team respectively. Typical analytical uses: player/team history, match outcomes, lineup lookups, joining player attributes to matches by player id and date.

accepted.name: player_latest_attributes
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  id,
  player_fifa_api_id,
  player_api_id,
  date,
  overall_rating,
  potential,
  preferred_foot,
  attacking_work_rate,
  defensive_work_rate,
  crossing,
  finishing,
  heading_accuracy,
  short_passing,
  volleys,
  dribbling,
  curve,
  free_kick_accuracy,
  long_passing,
  ball_control,
  acceleration,
  sprint_speed,
  agility,
  reactions,
  balance,
  shot_power,
  jumping,
  stamina,
  strength,
  long_shots,
  aggression,
  interceptions,
  positioning,
  vision,
  penalties,
  marking,
  standing_tackle,
  sliding_tackle,
  gk_diving,
  gk_handling,
  gk_kicking,
  gk_positioning,
  gk_reflexes,
  -- rank of snapshot per player_api_id by date desc (1 = most recent)
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY player_api_id ORDER BY datetime(date) DESC, id DESC) AS attr_snapshot_rank
FROM Player_Attributes
accepted.description: For each player (player_api_id and player_fifa_api_id), return the most recent Player_Attributes snapshot with its ratings and attributes. Useful to join a player's current/latest attributes to matches, teams, or player lists. | Use for: Join latest player attributes to Match lineups; List players with their current overall_rating/potential; Filter players by attribute thresholds (e.g., overall_rating) using the latest snapshot

accepted.name: league_with_country
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  League.id AS id,
  League.country_id AS country_id,
  League.name AS name,
  Country.name AS country_name
FROM League
LEFT JOIN Country ON League.country_id = Country.id
accepted.description: Denormalized league rows joined to their country name. One row per League.id with country metadata. Useful for reporting leagues by country and joining to matches aggregated by country. | Use for: List leagues along with country for filtering; Aggregate match counts by country via league join

accepted.name: match_goal_result_flags
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  id,
  match_api_id,
  date,
  season,
  league_id,
  home_team_api_id,
  away_team_api_id,
  home_team_goal,
  away_team_goal,
  (home_team_goal - away_team_goal) AS goal_difference,
  CASE WHEN home_team_goal > away_team_goal THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS home_win,
  CASE WHEN home_team_goal < away_team_goal THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS away_win,
  CASE WHEN home_team_goal = away_team_goal THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS draw
FROM Match
accepted.description: One row per match with derived result flags indicating home_win, away_win, draw and goal_difference. Useful for aggregations of outcomes and computing home advantage metrics. | Use for: Compute counts of home/away wins and draws by team/season/league; Analyze goal difference distributions
